title: Fragility of stealth solutions in mimetic gravity
summary: We study a broad class of constrained mimetic-type extensions of general relativity with action $S=\int{\rm d}^4x\sqrt{-g}\,\bigl(R/2+λ\,C[g,Ψ]+{\cal L}_{\rm m}\bigr)$, where $R$ is the Ricci scalar, $λ$ is a Lagrange multiplier, $C[g,Ψ]$ is a scalar functional of the metric and generic field content $Ψ$ (possibly involving $Ψ$ and its covariant derivatives) and ${\cal L}_{\rm m}$ is the matter Lagrangian.
